acceptance: Scale factors 3001 through 100000 are accepted for tpcds and tpcds_obt through the CLI, MCP and public API, with tests for each surface.
The official TPC-DS scale-point list again contains 10000, 30000 and 100000, and no stored or new bundle at those points is classed non-standard.
The 0.01 floor message and its no-spawn test are unchanged.
The changelog fragment no longer claims a 3000 maximum.
context: Filed 2026-11-20 from the adversarial review of the scale-factor and TPC-DI remediation work (PRs #4298-#4385 and benchbox-site #178-#210).
description:
## Problem
PR #4335 (f37e1c090e) lowered the accepted maximum for `tpcds` and `tpcds_obt` from 100000 to 3000 and filtered `OFFICIAL_SCALE_POINTS` to 3000. The owner did not approve a number. The evidence was one query's parameter generation (dsqgen query 9), but the cap refuses data generation (dsdgen never calls dsqgen and was not measured above 3000), every query subset, all of TPC-DS-OBT and the TPC-specified points 10000, 30000 and 100000 through the CLI, MCP and public API. `--official --scale 10000` prints that 10000 is not a TPC-specified scale factor, which is false. The changelog fragment marks the change non-breaking.

## Change
Restore `TPCDS_MAX_SCALE` behaviour to the shared 100000 maximum and the full official point list (1, 10, 100, 300, 1000, 3000, 10000, 30000, 100000) in `benchbox/core/tpcds/compliance.py` and `benchbox/core/benchmark_registry.py`. Keep the 0.01 floor and its message that the bundled dsdgen does not finish below it (owner-approved 2026-11-17). Restore the range tests changed by #4335. Replace the unreleased changelog fragment so it describes only the floor message. Check `benchbox/cli/benchmarks.py` interactive official mode agrees with the restored list.

## Decision gates
The 0.01 to 100000 range the owner selected on 2026-11-11 stands; the owner says the 3000 cap was not approved. Any lower maximum is an option of the query 9 decision item, not this item. Query 9 handling above the scale where dsqgen generates it is NOT part of this item; it is tpcds-q9-generation-above-sf5000-owner-decision-20261120. Do not add any new limit, timeout change or special case here.

## Verification rubric
Pass: `TPCDS(scale_factor=100000)` and `TPCDSOBT(scale_factor=100000)` construct; 100001 and 0.001 are refused; `--official --scale 10000` is accepted as an official point for tpcds; the 0.001 refusal still states the dsdgen reason and spawns no process; an MCP-level test covers the tpcds range; `git diff f37e1c090e^ HEAD --` on #4335's seven files shows only the floor message, its tests and the changelog; the new MCP and CLI range tests are additions elsewhere.

## Additions from the item review
- `prompt_official_mode` in benchbox/cli/benchmarks.py also offers 30 for TPC-DS, which predates #4335; report it, do not fix it here (interactive-official-mode-offers-sf30-for-tpcds-20261120).
- Worktree BenchBox.wt-restore-tpcds-range exists on branch fix/restore-tpcds-scale-range.

## Guardrails
- Any limit, default, threshold or label id or text is shown to the owner before it is committed. Briefs quote owner answers verbatim; questions to the owner carry no preselected answer.
- The implementer replies on review threads and leaves resolving them to the reviewer or the owner, unless the owner says otherwise (AGENTS.md asks agents to resolve benchbox-oracle threads on soundness paths; the owner has been asked which applies).
- Hosted writes (merge, close, disable or enable auto-merge, workflow dispatch, remote branch delete) only as the repository's close-out procedure or the owner's word for that pull request allows; never raw `gh pr merge` in core.
- No polling loop around `make pr-arm`, no `--no-verify`, no stand-in review unless the owner names the PR and head unprompted. Push only after `make pr-preflight` exits 0 on the exact head.
- No worktree takeover while another session may be working; no tracker write from a server that reports a stale version; never chain `git stash` with `git stash pop`.
- Heavy work runs only through `make heavy-run` or a lock-taking entry point, one run at a time.
- Status reports state only what merged and what was verified, with the evidence.
